notes: v1.0.90 - CRITICAL: silent updates fixed for real. Two installer bugs made every update fail silently (the launcher closed but never updated): (1) the branded splash hung the installer, (2) the old custom uninstaller aborted the upgrade with a fake 'uninstall' dialog. The splash is removed, the uninstaller only refuses when uninstalling interactively, and the updater now clears a stale old uninstaller before applying, so this update installs cleanly and future updates work automatically.
